title: A collapsed tool group rendered live partial output, shifting the pinned transcript
signal: selfRework pair: fix d7be986f on the same file 68 minutes after 0f7f3dd9

missed.summary: The change skipped only empty or blank partial output, so a collapsed group still added a preview row as soon as non-empty output arrived and removed it on completion; the added test even asserts the row count growing from 3 to 4. The follow-up fix removed live output from collapsed groups entirely. A reviewer should have reported that the guard narrows the movement instead of closing it.

fix.change: REVIEW.md gains a failure mode and a scope exception: collapsed cards, group preview rows and pinned footers render settled output only, and a change that still adds rows mid-call is reviewed as an incomplete fix rather than preExisting.
